entities.name: RlmN-like protein
observations: 347-aa query matches reviewed bacterial RlmN proteins at 70.7–72.3% identity and 98.6–99.4% query coverage; function is inferred by strong homology.
Reference RlmN annotations describe methylation of A2503 in 23S rRNA and A37 in tRNA; reference localization is cytoplasm.
Associated biological processes in references include rRNA base methylation and tRNA methylation.
